import json
from harness import *
fails=[]
LIM={'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
def jobd(events, services=None, limits=None):
    return {'services':services if services is not None else [{'name':'A','label':1},{'name':'B','label':2}],
            'limits':dict(LIM, **(limits or {})),'events':events}
def one(j):
    out,_=call(json.dumps({'jobs':[j]},separators=(',',':')))
    return out
def T(name, j, want):
    got=one(j)
    if not check(name,got,want): fails.append(name)
JOBINV={'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]}
INSP={'ok':True,'active':None,'images':[],'units':0,'contexts':0,'connections':0,'packets':0,'files':0}

# ---- services -------------------------------------------------------------
T('services empty', jobd([], services=[]), JOBINV)
T('services 17', jobd([], services=[{'name':'S%d'%i,'label':i+1} for i in range(17)]), JOBINV)
T('services 16', jobd([{'op':'inspect'}], services=[{'name':'S%d'%i,'label':i+1} for i in range(16)]), {'results':[{'events':[INSP]}]})
T('dup names', jobd([], services=[{'name':'A','label':1},{'name':'A','label':2}]), JOBINV)
T('dup labels', jobd([], services=[{'name':'A','label':1},{'name':'B','label':1}]), JOBINV)
T('label 0', jobd([], services=[{'name':'A','label':0}]), JOBINV)
T('label max-1 ok', jobd([{'op':'inspect'}], services=[{'name':'A','label':4294967294}]), {'results':[{'events':[INSP]}]})
T('label max', jobd([], services=[{'name':'A','label':4294967295}]), JOBINV)
T('name 24 ok', jobd([{'op':'inspect'}], services=[{'name':'A'+'b'*23,'label':1}]), {'results':[{'events':[INSP]}]})
T('name 25', jobd([], services=[{'name':'A'+'b'*24,'label':1}]), JOBINV)
T('name digit start', jobd([], services=[{'name':'1A','label':1}]), JOBINV)
T('service extra key', jobd([], services=[{'name':'A','label':1,'x':2}]), JOBINV)
T('service missing key', jobd([], services=[{'name':'A'}]), JOBINV)
T('service not dict', jobd([], services=['A']), JOBINV)

# ---- limits ---------------------------------------------------------------
for k,v in LIM.items():
    T('limit %s=0'%k, jobd([], limits={k:0}), JOBINV)
    T('limit %s=max+1'%k, jobd([], limits={k:v+1}), JOBINV)
    T('limit %s=float'%k, jobd([], limits={k:1.0}), JOBINV)
T('limit missing', {'services':[{'name':'A','label':1}],'limits':{k:v for k,v in LIM.items() if k!='images'},'events':[]}, JOBINV)
T('limit extra', jobd([], limits={'zzz':1}), JOBINV)
T('limit bool', jobd([], limits={'images':True}), JOBINV)

# ---- events ---------------------------------------------------------------
T('events not list', {'services':[{'name':'A','label':1}],'limits':LIM,'events':{}}, JOBINV)
T('unknown op', jobd([{'op':'nope'}]), JOBINV)
T('op missing', jobd([{'epoch':1}]), JOBINV)
T('op not string', jobd([{'op':1}]), JOBINV)
T('extra field', jobd([{'op':'inspect','x':1}]), JOBINV)
T('missing field', jobd([{'op':'commit'}]), JOBINV)
T('event not dict', jobd([[]]), JOBINV)
T('unit len2', jobd([{'op':'exit','unit':[1,1]}]), JOBINV)
T('unit ns -1', jobd([{'op':'exit','unit':[-1,1,1]}]), JOBINV)
T('unit pid 0', jobd([{'op':'exit','unit':[0,0,1]}]), JOBINV)
T('unit gen 0', jobd([{'op':'exit','unit':[0,1,0]}]), JOBINV)

T('rid 0', jobd([{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':0}]), JOBINV)

    return out

p2=' '.join('match(A) allow;' for _ in range(16384))
r=two([jobd([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':p2}]),jobd([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':p2}])])
check('atoms exactly 32768 ok', r['results'][0]['events'][0]['ok'], True) if 'results' in r else check('atoms exactly 32768 ok', r, {'error':'invalid'})
# invalid job does not contribute
T('invalid job excluded from totals', two([jobd([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':p1}]), jobd([], services=[])]),
   {'results':[{'events':[{'ok':True,'epoch':1,'image':{'accept':[False,True],'rows':[[4294967295,1],[4294967295,4294967295]]}}]},{'error':'invalid'}]} if False else two([jobd([{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':p1}]), jobd([], services=[])]))
